Full score requires all conditions, all task bodies at <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, conservative robot clearance >=0.02 m for one continuous second. reset_notes: Reset the native environment, restore every body and joint to scene.json, settle, then clear scorer history. Two independent full-score trials remain required.
fidelity: Engineering draft; unvalidated rigid primitives and passive joints. The gravity-loaded lid and its contact clearances require native validation. The draft expert only includes a lid-handle approach, not a calibrated hinge-following motion. The two modules currently share proxy geometry; component-specific interfaces, keys and retainers must be implemented before claiming a heterogeneous servicing construct. An independent novelty case beyond concatenating existing maintenance tasks remains unresolved.
